tur: Top 5 lists about money, motivation and starting a business (stick-figure animation)
ozet: Daily Top 5 countdown Shorts in English: ways to make money, business ideas, habits of successful people, mistakes that keep people broke, lessons from founders. Narrated by the channel owner (own cloned voice), fast and energetic.
kurallar: Everything must be realistic and verifiable: no get-rich-quick promises, no guaranteed income claims, no fake statistics. Use cautious wording ('can', 'many people', 'often').
No financial, legal or investment advice for specific products, stocks or crypto; no naming of scams or pyramid schemes as opportunities.
Real people and companies may be mentioned only with well-known, verifiable facts; never invent quotes.
yazim: Write EVERYTHING in English: title, description, tags, lines, cards (buyukYazi, sira, kapanis). For the field format see diziler/ornek/oyun-top5-shorts.json; length and structure follow the rules below.

FAST SHORTS (every Short): 4-5 sentences, 55-90 words total, 5 scenes, 'hiz': 1.2. The title and the giant on-screen text in scene 1 state a PROBLEM the viewer has; the video gives the SOLUTION: 3 concrete fixes.

Problem patterns: 'Broke by the 20th every month?', 'No money to start a business?', 'Stuck in a job that pays too little?', 'Can't save a single dollar?', 'No time for a side hustle?', 'Afraid to start because you might fail?'. Never repeat a problem or the same three fixes (check done/ and recentTitles).

Scene 1 problem: mekan 'garaj', 'ofis' or 'fuar'; buyukYazi {ust: the problem in 1-2 words ≤14 (e.g. 'ALWAYS BROKE?', 'NO CAPITAL?'), alt: short line ≤30}; the 'girisimci' character in a worried pose (dusun, omuz). ONE sentence: ask the problem as a question.

Scenes 2-4 solution: mekan 'siralama', sira {no: 3→1, ad: fix name ≤28, tur: short category ≤30, maddeler: exactly 3 short points ≤24 each}. ONE short punchy sentence per scene: the fix and why it works. Number one gets efektler ['beyaz-cakma']. No kadraj on siralama scenes.

Scene 5 call to action: mekan 'fuar', kalabalik 1, 'girisimci' in zafer pose with esya 'kupa' or 'para'. ONE sentence that contains both 'subscribe' and 'like' (e.g. 'Subscribe and like for the rest of the series, and tell me which fix you would try first!'). kapanis {baslik: 'SUBSCRIBE', sonraki: 'Subscribe and like for more', soru: problem-specific question}.
Use cautious wording, no income guarantees. Do not write muzik or muzikSeviye.

Title: states the problem, curiosity-driven, ≤60 characters, ends with one emoji (💰, 🚀, 🧠). First description line names the problem with keywords and asks a question; then 3-5 hashtags like #money #business #motivation #sidehustle.

LONG VIDEO (type long, weekly on Saturday): 8-10 minute Top 10 in English (horizontal). Structure: 1) Intro scene (kisim 'Intro', mekan 'fuar' or 'ofis', buyukYazi {ust: 'TOP 10'}, hook + "Let's count down!"). 2) For each rank: a 'siralama' scene (sira {no, ad, tur, maddeler: 3}) with 2-3 sentences, then one illustration scene (mekan 'garaj', 'ofis', 'grafik' with veri, or 'fuar'; characters girisimci/calisan/yatirimci/ogrenci; buyukYazi for a number) with 2-4 sentences: a concrete example, how to start, a realistic caveat. 3) Four chapters via kisim: 'Intro', '10-7', '6-4', '3-1'. 4) Closing: 'fuar', question + subscribe call. Write 'hiz': 1.1. Total words targetWords ±30%. thumbnailText (≤4 words, e.g. 'START WITH $0') and kapak {sahne: an illustration scene with characters on the right half, not a siralama scene}. titleAlt, thumbnailTextAlt and thumbnailTextAlt2 are required (3-thumbnail test: three different angles). One short "subscribe for the rest of the series" line at the end of the intro, and a "subscribe and like" call in the closing are required.

On long-video days the Short uses the same topic as that day's Top 10: same problem, the top 3 fixes, and the last sentence says the full list is in the long video on the channel (together with the subscribe + like call).
